# TigreGótico

> FOSS AI and voice technology specialists. We build privacy-first voice
> assistants, custom TTS models, and web applications. We create and maintain
> the HiveMind stack and are core contributors to OpenVoiceOS.

## Core Information
- [Home](https://tigregotico.pt/): Overview of services, featured projects, and latest updates.
- [About](https://tigregotico.pt/about): The team, our mission in open-source voice tech, and our role in the OpenVoiceOS ecosystem.
- [Services](https://tigregotico.pt/services): Data extraction & datasets, voice interfaces for anything, custom TTS voice training and ASR model fine-tuning, minority-language speech tech, and FOSS-first web development.
- [Contact](https://tigregotico.pt/contact): Project inquiries and FOSS collaboration.

## Projects & Resources
- [Games](https://tigregotico.pt/games): Accessible text and voice games — classic interactive fiction to LLM-generated worlds, in the terminal or by voice.
- [Open Source](https://tigregotico.pt/projects): Open-source libraries and tools, community collaborations, and work donated to OpenVoiceOS.
- [Blog](https://tigregotico.pt/blog): Articles on voice AI, OpenVoiceOS development, and synthetic data.
- [Demo](https://tigregotico.pt/demo): Browser-based text-to-speech demo, no install required.

## External Links
- [GitHub](https://github.com/TigreGotico): Open-source repositories.
- [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/TigreGotico): AI models and datasets.
- [OpenVoiceOS](https://openvoiceos.org): An independent non-profit open-source voice platform we are core contributors to; our founder serves on its board.
